provider.label: Backend
provider.help: Which backend to use. Defaults to "cloud" (Redis Agent Memory) unless an existing self-hosted config is detected.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.help: Base URL of the backend: the Redis Agent Memory cloud endpoint (falls back to ${AGENT_MEMORY_ENDPOINT}) when using the cloud provider, or the self-hosted agent-memory-server URL otherwise.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.help: API key for authentication. Required for the cloud provider (sent as the Redis Agent Memory bearer token; falls back to ${AGENT_MEMORY_API_KEY}). Optional for self-hosted.

bearerToken.label: Bearer Token
bearerToken.help: Bearer token for authentication (self-hosted only; optional). Not supported with the cloud provider — use API Key instead.

storeId.label: Store ID
storeId.help: Redis Agent Memory store id (cloud provider only, or use ${AGENT_MEMORY_STORE_ID})

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.help: Namespace for organizing memories (isolates memories by app, team, or project)

userId.label: User ID
userId.help: Optional. Set explicitly for per-user isolation. If omitted, memory is scoped only by namespace.

workingMemorySessionId.label: Working Memory Session ID
workingMemorySessionId.help: Fixed session ID for working memory. If set, uses this instead of deriving from the OpenClaw session. Useful for demos that should keep one continuous session.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture important information from conversations

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context

assistantCapture.label: Assistant Capture
assistantCapture.help: Include assistant turns for memory extraction, or exclude them to minimize retained data

sensitiveDataRedaction.label: Sensitive Data Redaction
sensitiveDataRedaction.help: Apply opt-in heuristic redaction for common secrets and personal identifiers before capture

sessionRetentionSeconds.label: Session Retention (seconds)
sessionRetentionSeconds.help: Self-hosted working-memory TTL. Not supported by Redis Agent Memory cloud.

recallRecordMaxChars.label: Recall Record Limit
recallRecordMaxChars.help: Maximum characters from one record in automatic recall context

recallContextMaxChars.label: Recall Context Limit
recallContextMaxChars.help: Maximum characters in the complete automatic recall envelope

minScore.label: Minimum Score
minScore.help: Minimum similarity score for memory recall (0-1)

recallLimit.label: Recall Limit
recallLimit.help: Maximum number of memories to recall

extractionStrategy.label: Extraction Strategy
extractionStrategy.help: How to extract memories: discrete (semantic/episodic), summary, preferences, or custom

customPrompt.label: Custom Extraction Prompt
customPrompt.placeholder: Extract action items and decisions from this conversation.
customPrompt.help: Custom prompt for memory extraction (only used with 'custom' strategy)

summaryViewName.label: Summary View Name
summaryViewName.help: Name for the rolling summary view of long-term memories

summaryTimeWindowDays.label: Summary Time Window (days)
summaryTimeWindowDays.help: Rolling window in days for the summary view (only recent memories included)

summaryGroupBy.label: Summary Group By
summaryGroupBy.help: Fields to partition summaries by: user_id, namespace, or both

recallDescription.label: Recall Tool Description
recallDescription.placeholder: Search through long-term memories. Use when you need context about user preferences, past decisions, or previously discussed topics.
recallDescription.help: Description shown to the LLM for the memory_recall tool

storeDescription.label: Store Tool Description
storeDescription.placeholder: Save important information in long-term memory. Use for preferences, facts, decisions.
storeDescription.help: Description shown to the LLM for the memory_store tool

forgetDescription.label: Forget Tool Description
forgetDescription.placeholder: Delete a specific memory from an authorized scope.
forgetDescription.help: Description shown to the LLM for the memory_forget tool

scopes.label: Named Scopes
scopes.help: Optional named memory boundaries for multi-agent setups. Each scope can override namespace, userId, extraction, and summary settings.

agentScopes.label: Agent Scope Routing
agentScopes.help: Optional mapping from OpenClaw agent ID to named scopes for recall, capture, and tool defaults.
